dialog.english: Tai! It's the Koromon village!

Yeah. Although we were just here,
it feels like we've been away for
a long time.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Aunque estuvimos aquí
hace poco, parece que ha
pasado mucho tiempo.

dialog.english: Tai...

So, why'd you say we should return
to the Koromon village?
dialog.translation:
Bueno, ¿por qué dijiste que
volviéramos a la aldea
Koromon?

dialog.english: It was my idea.
Sora?

There might be a way to get
Koromon to evolve again.
dialog.translation:
Puede que haya forma de
que Koromon evolucione.

dialog.english:
After all, not only was there a
Crest hidden here, but there was
also a transfer device.
dialog.translation:
Al fin y al cabo, aquí
había un Emblema escondido
y un dispositivo de transporte.

dialog.english:
There's prolly some kinda legend
'bout evolution here, too.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que también hay
leyendas sobre evolución
por aquí.

dialog.english:
Thanks, guys! Thanks for coming,
for me and Koromon!
Cheer up, Tai.
Yeah. I can't stay down forever.
dialog.translation: Sí. No puedo estar triste siempre.

dialog.english: That's right, Tai!

Now, let's listen to what the
Koromon have to say.
...so that's why.

Do you know of any way to get
Koromon to evolve again?
dialog.translation:
¿Sabéis de alguna forma de
que Koromon evolucione?

dialog.english:
Unfortunately, we don't have any
legends about evolution.
dialog.translation:
Por desgracia, no tenemos
leyendas sobre evolución.

dialog.english:
If there were a way, we would have
used it already.
dialog.translation:
Si hubiera una forma, ya la
habríamos usado.

dialog.english: Yeah, you're right.

But that's bad. It means you won't
be able to evolve again, right?
dialog.translation:
Pero eso es malo. Significa
que no podrás evolucionar
de nuevo, ¿no?

dialog.english: That might just be how it is...
dialog.translation: Puede que sea así, sin más...

dialog.english: Ah, now that you mention it...
D-did you come up with something?

It's got nothing to do with
evolution, but I do know a legend
about invigoration medicine.
dialog.translation:
No tiene que ver con
evolucionar, pero sé de una
leyenda de tónico vigorizante.

dialog.english: Invigoration medicine?

Yeah! If you drink it when you get
sick, you'll feel a great power
from your body!
dialog.translation:
¡Sí! ¡Si lo bebes cuando
estás enfermo, sentirás un
gran poder en tu cuerpo!

dialog.english: So where is this medicine?

We can make it for you if you
bring us DigiPinecones!

They grow on the farthest tree
from the village.
dialog.translation:
Crecen en el árbol más
lejano de la aldea.

dialog.english:
Let's go, guys! I'll do anything
for Koromon!
dialog.translation:
¡Vamos, chicos! ¡Haré lo que
sea por Koromon!

dialog.english: That's the spirit, Tai!
Tai, that must be it!
So those are DigiPinecones!

We did it, Tai! Let's hurry
back to the Koromon village.
dialog.translation:
¡Lo logramos, Tai! Volvamos
rápido a la aldea Koromon.

dialog.english: Wait right there!
Gazimon!
What do you want?

Don't you know who this tree
belongs to?
dialog.translation:
¿No sabéis de quién es
este árbol?

dialog.english:
It grew from seeds we threw on the
roadside a long time ago! In other
words, those pinecones are ours!
dialog.translation:
¡Creció de semillas que
tiramos hace tiempo! ¡Esas
piñas son nuestras!

dialog.english: That is *such* a blatant lie!
Shut up!
Gyah!
Gyah!
Sora!

Don't do such horrible things to
my friends!
dialog.translation:
¡No les hagáis eso a mis
amigos!

dialog.english: How's that? Wanna go again?
Tch! I'll remember this!
Are you okay, Sora?

It's no big deal. Let's go back to
the Koromon village.
dialog.translation:
No es nada. Volvamos a la
aldea Koromon.

dialog.english:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Here's
the invigoration medicine.
dialog.translation:
¡Siento la espera! Aquí
tenéis el tónico vigorizante.

dialog.english: Go on, chug it down in one shot!
Let's go! *gulp*...*gulp*
*gulp, gulp*
*gulp, gulp*
*gulp, gulp*
So how was it?
G-grooooooss!
Bleeeeeh, it tastes terrible.

That's strange, I'm sure we made
it correctly...
dialog.translation:
Qué raro, seguro que lo
hicimos bien...

dialog.english:
You're awful for making us drink
that!
Awful! Awful!

Well, you certainly look
invigorated... with anger.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, desde luego parecéis
vigorizados... de rabia.

dialog.english:
Perhaps it was meant to be
something like shock therapy.
dialog.translation:
Quizás era una especie de
terapia de choque.

dialog.english:
We only heard legends about this,
we really didn't know... Please
take this in apology.
dialog.translation:
Solo oímos leyendas, de
verdad no lo sabíamos...
Aceptad esto como disculpa.

dialog.english: Hmph, all right, give it to us.

Sorry, Tai. This wouldn't have
happened if I hadn't suggested
that we come here.
dialog.translation:
Perdona, Tai. Esto no habría
pasado si no hubiera
sugerido venir aquí.

dialog.english:
It's okay, it's the thought that
counts. Despite all that happened,
it really meant a lot.
dialog.translation:
Tranquila, la intención
es lo que cuenta. Pese a
todo, significó mucho.

dialog.english: So don't worry about it.

That's right. I hope you feel like
yourself again, Tai.
dialog.translation:
Eso es. Espero que vuelvas
a ser tú mismo, Tai.

dialog.english:
We can make the invigoration
medicine if we have DigiPinecones.
dialog.translation:
Podemos hacer el tónico
vigorizante si tenemos
DigiPiñas.

dialog.english:
The DigiPinecones grow on the
farthest tree from the village.
dialog.translation:
Las DigiPiñas crecen en el
árbol más lejano de la
aldea.

dialog.english:
If we could evolve, we'd have
taken care of the Pagumon and
Etemon ourselves...
dialog.translation:
Si pudiéramos evolucionar,
nos habríamos encargado de
los Pagumon y Etemon...

dialog.english:
Huh? Weren't you an Agumon back
then?
Yeah. A lot of stuff happened...

Etemon came here and destroyed
this town, too. Look at this road!
dialog.translation:
Etemon vino y destruyó
también este pueblo. ¡Mira
esta carretera!

dialog.english:
We have legends about how to make
a variety of medicines.
dialog.translation:
Tenemos leyendas sobre
cómo hacer varias medicinas.

dialog.english:
Hey, Joe, can you teach me how to
make mouthwash?
dialog.translation:
Oye, Joe, ¿me enseñas a
hacer enjuague bucal?

dialog.english: Eh, why me?
Because you're always shouting.
That's enough from you!

I've just been bothering everyone,
in the end.
dialog.translation:
Al final solo he sido una
molestia para todos.

dialog.english: What are you saying, Tai?!

You've always been getting us out
of trouble!
Sora...

So right now, we have to help you,
too.
dialog.translation:
Así que ahora te
ayudamos nosotros.

dialog.english: What Sora said!

Don't act like you're bothering
us.
Sorry, Sora. Thanks, guys!
